description:
Size a bulk lead-sourcing run WITHOUT submitting it. Takes exactly the arguments submit_bulk_lead_sourcing takes (the server validates both through one request model), and writes nothing, queues nothing and spends nothing. For some sources it may read the source's public listing once to check the chosen values have something behind them — a refusal here is the refusal submit would give, found before anything is committed.

Returns: estimated_queries (the queries x geo count), estimated_records (an upper bound), estimated_cost_usd + has_cost, source_is_free, records_cap + would_exceed_cap (true = submit would be refused with 429 — narrow the run), the resolved per-lead workflow, and duration.

QUOTE RECORDS, COST AND DURATION TOGETHER. duration is how long the run takes at THIS account's own throughput, and it is the only place a duration lives — submit's 202 carries none, and a large run legitimately takes hours to days.
  * duration.human is the sentence to show the user.
  * duration.hours null = the server could not work it out (unresolved_reason says why). Never render it as 0.
  * bound_by "daily" = a 24-hour quota sets the pace, so the run takes longer than records / jobs_per_hour.

MONEY: estimated_cost_usd null / has_cost false is NOT free — it can mean no unit cost is configured for a PAID source. Only source_is_free=true licenses "free", and even then the downstream enrichment (leads x enabled stages) still spends.

A source not offered to this account is refused here exactly like an unknown name; list_bulk_sources shows what this account can use. The same reach as submit: sources that need an uploaded file or a saved selection are not reachable through this tool.

filters.description: Provider-specific knobs. The adapter refuses any key that would overwrite a field this request already owns.

geo.description: Geographic targets. A labelled entry multiplies the query list; a coordinate-only entry steers the search centre.

country_code.description: ISO 2-letter code. A LOCALE hint only — it does NOT steer the search centre.

label.description: Human-readable place appended to each query, e.g. 'Atlanta, Georgia, USA'. THIS is what places the search.

max_records_per_query.description: Records the provider returns per expanded query (1..100000). Omit for the platform default.

max_total_records.description: Ceiling on total records across the whole job (1..1000000).

priority.description: Queue priority for the fanned-out leads (0-10, default 5).

provider.description: Registered lead-source adapter name, resolved server-side. list_bulk_sources is the authoritative live list for this account — call it rather than trusting the names here. PAID: 'outscraper', 'apify'. FREE at the source: 'sortlist'. Also registered but NOT submittable through this tool (they need source.upload / source.selection, which this tool does not send): 'csv', 'json', 'internal'.

queries.description: Search terms, bare (e.g. ["restaurants", "cafes"]). The effective search list is queries x geo labels.

source_kind.description: Shape of the source, and what bounds stage eligibility. Must be one the chosen provider registers — list_bulk_sources reports each source's source_kinds and eligible_stages. 'google_maps' (every stage) | 'sortlist_agency' (NO vayapin — republication, not a missing address) | 'unenriched_run' or 'corpus_query' (internal corpus, every stage) | 'linkedin_company' (NO vayapin — no address, no place_id; declared, no adapter yet).

test.description: Route to test queues; no production side effects.

workflow.description: Which downstream stages each sourced lead runs through. Same shape as a campaign. vayapin publishes a PERMANENT public profile — set it explicitly.

smartlead.description: Export verified leads into a LIVE outreach campaign at completion. { enabled: boolean, connection_id?: string, remote_campaign_id?: string }

social_media_enrichment.description: Recover contacts from social handles. { enabled: boolean }

spidersite.description: Crawl each lead’s website. { enabled: boolean, mode?: string }

spiderverify.description: Verify extracted emails. { enabled: boolean } — requires spidersite.

vayapin.description: Publish a permanent public map profile, with no un-publish path. { enabled: boolean } — eligible for google_maps, unenriched_run and corpus_query; a 422 for sortlist_agency and linkedin_company.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: estimate_bulk_lead_sourcing
